safety_verdicts.content: Patient has tried E45 cream and antihistamines with minimal relief.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated only states an OTC moisturising cream with minimal benefit and does not include antihistamine trial or specifically E45 as in Gold.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting the specific OTC products tried (E45 and antihistamines) slightly reduces the usefulness of the history for assessing prior response, but it is unlikely to change diagnosis or immediate safety-critical decisions. The main management (avoid irritants, emollients, topical steroid) would be similar regardless.

safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Gold lists metformin; Generated states medications not clearly documented.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Failing to document metformin can lead to inaccurate medication reconciliation and missed consideration of diabetes control and drug interactions (e.g., during acute illness or when prescribing additional meds). This can contribute to clinically meaningful downstream harm if the medication is stopped or overlooked.
